bio_en: Dānapāla, known in Chinese as Shihu, was an Indian monk active in the Northern Song translation institute. He arrived in the Song capital in 980 and translated a large body of Buddhist literature. His works include the extensive Chinese translation of the Sarvatathagatatattvasamgraha, an important scripture of esoteric Buddhism.
bio_summary: 施護，北印度僧也，宋太平興國間入京，入譯經院譯梵典。所譯經典甚富，《一切如來真實攝大乘現證三昧大教王經》為金剛頂初會之全譯。
